visual_name: Truchet arc tile field with radial recolour
code_name: Quarter-circle tiles turned by a wave
summary: A black field of thick white quarter-circle arcs forms an endless maze; a circular wave from the centre turns each tile 90 degrees and paints it orange, then a second wave turns them back to white.
